cases.case_label: Founder SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP) - TAF1-32i biomarker in EVs
cases.mechanism_detail: The retrotransposon in TAF1 intron 32 causes mis-splicing with retention of intron 32 (TAF1-32i) and reduced TAF1; XDP patient iPSC-derived NPCs implanted in mouse brain showed a 24-fold increase of TAF1-32i, detectable in extracellular vesicles.
